protocol.startup: Hold eta=[1,1] until each full window is available. All are full before the fault.
protocol.estimator: Per-wheel LS: eta=sum(u*y)/sum(u^2); causal sliding window; no reset or clipping.
protocol.reference: Unchanged fixed model and EMA alpha=0.05. Window lengths intentionally have different mean sample ages.
protocol.steady_metrics: RMSE, within-run jitter SD, bias, and fraction of samples within left error 0.05.
protocol.recovery: Left error <=0.05 for 0.5 s; delay includes hold time. First qualified interval does not imply permanent stability.
protocol.failure_handling: Failed runs retained; infinite recovery for overall median (stored as null).
protocol.aggregation: Descriptive mean over four preset phases x paired seeds; phases are not independent noise trials.
protocol.noise: Same Gaussian measurement samples across methods, windows and profiles; same numeric sigma for v and omega in their own units.
protocol.causality: eta[k] predicts k+1. Observing k+1 updates eta[k+1]. Truth and change time used only for plant and scoring.
protocol.scope: Known other dynamics, smooth positive exogenous commands, one sustained efficiency change, no process noise or closed-loop control.
